ASIA FM Taiwan Inc. (officially known in Chinese as Asia Broadcasting Co., Ltd., and commonly referred to as the Asia Broadcasting Network or Asia Radio Family) is a highly influential private regional commercial radio network in northern Taiwan. Headquartered in Taoyuan City, the station’s signal primarily covers Keelung, the Greater Taipei area, Taoyuan, Hsinchu, and Miaoli County, and has consistently maintained extremely high listenership ratings in the Taoyuan-Hsinchu-Miaoli region.

Best Corporation (P) Limited (BCPL) is one of the pioneers in the manufacturing of knitted garments at Tirupur, India. BCPL is an integrated textile company having operations from spinning to garmenting. Established in the year 1967 with 25 machines, it has grown steadily over the years and is today a USD $125 million enterprise. BCPL employs about 10,000 people and is one of the leading exporters of knitted garments from Tirupur. BCPL produces knitted garments for Men, Women, Teeners, Schoolers and Toddlers for the world market and specialises in Underwear and Baby wear. BCPL also sells ring spun yarn & finished fabric from 20’s NE to 60’s NE to the domestic and export market. BCPL’s operations are managed by Mr. R. Rajkumar, Vice Chairman & Managing Director and Mr. R. Aadithya, Director under the guidance from BEST S.Ramasamy, Chairman of Best Corporation (P) Limited.
